description: Screen a flagship bullion coin's measured weight/diameter/thickness against official specifications (Numista catalogue and issuing-mint published specs) with a red-flag verdict outside tolerance; educational, not proof of authenticity. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

product.description: Product slug, canonical product ID, or coin name (e.g. 'Silver Eagle', 'Krugerrand', 'Morgan dollar').
